correctness.rationale: For the specified order-two four-step BDFL coefficients and exactly alternating positive steps h,rh, consistency isolates a simple constant mode and a three-state parasitic companion C(w). Substituting the actual local time nodes gives u(r),v(r)=u(1/r); their product has cubic char polynomial z³-Tz²+Ez-V. The factorized strict cubic Schur signs reduce on s=r+r^{-1}>=2 to one critical quadratic, with s* and R=4.2228260449... as printed; the other Schur inequalities stay positive up to s*, and for s>s* the real cubic has a root <-1. At equality -1 is simple and the other two modes lie inside unit circle, so propagators remain bounded. At r=4 the frozen companion determinant u(4)>1 even as the monodromy decays. This establishes uniform zero-stability only for the named periodic zero-dynamics method; numerical scans are supplementary and source-paper coefficient attribution is not independently verified because access to that paper was blocked.
